newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan sells 60,000/T Jan fuel oil at $121-$122/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sells 60,000/T Jan fuel oil at $121-$122/T.

text.p: State-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) sold 60,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil at $121-$122 per tonne on a free-on-board Kaohsiung basis for January 11-30 loading, a company official said on Thursday.
The tender which sought two 30,000-tonne cargoes of 3.0 percent sulphur grade fuel oil closed on December 18 and was valid until December 20.

Earlier this month, CPC has sold by term tender between four and six cargoes of 3.0 percent sulphur fuel oil at $3.50-$4.00 per tonne premium to Singapore spot quotes, fob Koahsiung for January to June loading in 1997.
